title: Fight bite
stem: Cubicle 8. Mr Pang, 25, punched someone in the mouth in a bar fight 6 hours ago. He has a small cut over a knuckle of his right hand. Take a history, look at the wound, and counsel him.
notes:
Checked against NICE NG184 (Human and animal bites: antimicrobial prescribing, 2020), BSSH hand surgery guidance, and CHP / UKHSA guidance on blood-borne virus exposure.

A laceration over a metacarpophalangeal joint after a punch is a human bite until proven otherwise. Teeth penetrate the extensor tendon and joint capsule with the fist clenched; when the hand opens, the tendon slides and hides the tract. Oral flora (streptococci, Staphylococcus aureus, Eikenella corrodens, anaerobes) cause septic arthritis, tenosynovitis and osteomyelitis.

Manage: X-ray (tooth fragment, fracture of the metacarpal head, air in the joint); irrigate; do not close primarily; co-amoxiclav prophylaxis (NICE: for human bites that break the skin and draw blood) — doxycycline plus metronidazole if penicillin-allergic; tetanus; blood-borne virus risk assessment (HBV vaccination, HCV and HIV testing; PEP rarely indicated unless the source is known high risk with blood in saliva). Refer to hand surgeons for exploration and washout if the joint or tendon may be involved (most fight bites over the MCP joint), or if presenting late or infected.

Your notes match this; they could add the X-ray and early hand surgery referral for exploration.

steps.label: History
steps.hint: Mechanism, time, hand dominance, occupation, symptoms, tetanus, BBV risk, PMH.

Injury.t: How exactly did you hurt your hand?
Injury.r: Punched a guy in the mouth. Hit his teeth.
Injury.mark: Establishes a closed-fist injury against teeth

Injury.t: Pain, swelling, redness, fever, can you move your fingers?
Injury.r: Throbbing, bit swollen. Hurts to straighten my middle finger.
Injury.mark: Asks symptoms of infection and tendon/joint involvement

Background.t: Which is your writing hand? What do you do for work?

Background.r: Penicillin gives me a rash. Otherwise healthy.

Blood-borne viruses.t: Was the other man bleeding from the mouth? Do you know anything about him?
Blood-borne viruses.r: His lip was bleeding. Don't know him.

steps.label: Examine and investigate
steps.hint: Look with the fist clenched; tendon function; X-ray.

Exam.t: Look at the wound with the fist clenched and open
Exam.r: A 6 mm laceration over the 3rd MCP joint; with the fist clenched it lines up with a hole in the extensor hood.
Exam.mark: Examines the wound with the fist clenched

Exam.r: Pain on extension against resistance; pain on passive movement of the MCP joint.

Imaging.r: No fracture, no foreign body. A small bubble of air in the 3rd MCP joint.
Imaging.mark: X-ray for fracture, tooth fragment and joint air

steps.label: Counsel
steps.hint: Explain the risk, antibiotics, no stitches, hand surgeons, BBV, red flags.

turns.line: It's just a small cut. Can you stitch it and let me go?

opts.t: It looks small, but teeth have gone into the knuckle joint. Mouth bacteria cause serious infection that can destroy the joint. We won't stitch it; you need antibiotics and the hand surgeons to wash out the joint.
opts.mark: Explains the risk of joint infection and the plan

opts.t: As a chef your hand is your living. A washout now avoids a stiff, infected finger later. Because you're allergic to penicillin, we'll use doxycycline and metronidazole, and give a tetanus booster.
opts.mark: Appropriate antibiotics for penicillin allergy and tetanus

turns.line: Can I catch anything from his blood?

opts.t: There's a small risk of hepatitis and HIV from blood in saliva. You're protected against hepatitis B; we'll take baseline blood tests today and repeat them later. HIV medicines aren't usually needed for this type of exposure.
opts.mark: Counsels on blood-borne virus risk and testing

qs.q: Why examine with the fist clenched?
qs.a: The tendon tract lines up with the wound in that position

Should a fight bite be sutured?

badge.name: Knuckle Sandwich
badge.flavor: Small cut over a knuckle after a punch: it's in the joint until proved otherwise.

cards.q: A laceration over the MCP joint after a punch should be treated as…
options: A human bite with possible joint penetration

cards.q: Antibiotic for a human bite with penicillin allergy (NICE)?
X-ray in a fight bite looks for…
options: Fracture, tooth fragment, air in the joint

cards.q: Primary closure of a fight bite?

cards.why: Resistant to clindamycin; co-amoxiclav covers it.

cards.q: Tetanus for a bite in someone last vaccinated >10 years ago?
